question: Approve the ideation direction: require a strict conn citation on FO-actor gate resolutions, refuse it on captain resolutions, and pin the recorded-gate-lifecycle grader to the FO actor?

artifacts.summary: Ideation settled the load-bearing question against its own seed: the auto-continue prompt grants NO conn, so those runs stay with own-sonnet-gate-conn-bypass and this task lands on recorded-gate-lifecycle, where the conn is granted verbatim and finding 9 shows misattribution grading green. Design: strict conn {quote, source} on the Resolution, required on FO-actor decisions and refused on captain decisions (exit 2, no mutation); grader stops deriving the expected actor from the FO's own command and authenticates the quote against the runbook it authored; misattribution reds under conn-approval-misattributed. Auto-continue keeps its RED and gains a boundary negative proving the citation confers no authority. Net +150 across 11 files.
